title: Above The Noise
text: This was a once in a lifetime experience and that is not an exaggeration. The staff of JetScoot and the crew of the vessel were enthusiastic, expert, and incredibly helpful. There was a wheelchair bound young lady on our trip and they treated her with amazing kindness and care. Seeing her smile when the parasail began lifting her up with her caregiver was so beautiful. Our flight was wonderfully quiet and felt like freedom. I can’t say enough good things about JetScoot. If we ever go to Barcelona again we will surely go back again.

title: Perfect
text:

Tatiana was warm and friendly, explaining everything clearly and making sure we were relaxed before takeoff.
